definition.simple: How much of each dollar of revenue is left as profit.
definition.balanced: Gross margin = gross profit ÷ revenue. Operating margin = operating profit ÷ revenue. Net margin = net income ÷ revenue. A thin margin leaves little room: a small rise in costs can wipe out the profit.

example: Operating profit 40 on revenue 450: operating margin = 8.9% (fictional, millions USD).
